english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when the context makes clear that you mean someone's way of living rather than life in general.
Use this for someone’s everyday life or way of living, including work, family, and other areas of life, and also when “life” means a livelihood.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 ji4 gaa1 ni1 zung2 sang1 wut6

examples.english: After moving to the countryside, my life became much more relaxed.
examples.traditional: 搬咗去郊區之後，我嘅生活輕鬆咗好多。
examples.jyutping: bun1 zo2 heoi3 gaau1 keoi1 zi1 hau6 ngo5 ge3 sang1 wut6 hing1 sung1 zo2 hou2 do1
